title: AI-Powered Personalized Learning for Neurodivergent Students
summary: A planned special-education pilot aims to adapt teaching to students' cognitive and emotional needs. Learning and well-being effects are not yet reported.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: A special-education prototype is planned for a pilot that would adapt teaching to students' cognitive and emotional needs. Learning and well-being effects are unreported.
purpose: Tailor learning pace and support to neurodivergent students' needs.
system: AI personalized-learning system for neurodivergent students

ratings.reason: Neurodivergent learners are intended to receive adaptive support and lower cognitive overload.
Schools and educators are intended to improve support decisions; no actual result is supplied.

ai_role.statement: The project account does not separately evaluate AI’s contribution to the benefit.

evidence.citation: Project account in International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact, 2025. Information current as of June 2025. Outcomes are reported by the project team. The account provides no independent outcome evaluation.
evidence.title: Use case 6: AI-Powered Personalized Learning for Neurodivergent Students

produced_by: Conditions that could produce the benefit are unspecified.
must_hold: Special-education expertise and contextual learner feedback

headline: Adaptive AI learning for neurodivergent students
claim_basis: Sources: the makers' report. The cited evidence includes no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
